items.title: Read a request and result
items.instructions: Read the account and identify the decision and completed help.

payload.stimulus: A sudden wind scattered Bao’s papers. He made a decision to ask Kim for help. Kim gathered the pages and clipped them together.

answers.answer: He decided to ask Kim for help.
Kim gathered and clipped the pages together.

items.title: Complete the interrupted action
items.instructions: Use the past continuous form of carry.

payload.stimulus: Mai ___ a box when the rain began.
payload.explanation: Was carrying describes the action already in progress.
payload.spelling_policy: Require the two-word form was carrying.

items.title: Match focus to correction
items.instructions: Match each context to the word that should receive corrective focus.

left.text: It was Lan, not Minh, who helped.

payload.explanation: The corrected person or object receives the strongest focus.

items.title: Respond to a request
items.instructions: First read the classmate's request; then respond as the helper and state exactly what you will carry.

payload.communicative_goal: Take part in a two-stage request-and-help exchange and make the new object clear.
constraints: Begin with: First, my classmate asked me for help carrying two folders.
Then respond as the helper in one sentence and mention two folders.
payload.expected_output: Two connected sentences that sequence the request before the helpful response and name the item and quantity.

rubric.criterion: The response directly accepts or answers the request.
First and then clearly place the request before the response.
Two folders is clear as the new information.

items.title: Translate the completed help
items.instructions: Translate the English sentence into Vietnamese.

payload.source_text: Finally, An helped Mai carry the books home.
payload.intended_meaning: The final event is An assisting Mai with taking books home.
payload.primary_answer: Cuối cùng, An đã giúp Mai mang sách về nhà.
acceptable_variants: Cuối cùng, An đã giúp Mai mang sách về nhà.
payload.scoring_guidance: Preserve the final-event marker, helper, person helped, books, and destination.
